---
title: "Leaflet example"
description: >
  Check **leaflet** widgets styling inside **pkgdown** articles.
---

```{r}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(leaflet)

data(quakes)
outline <- quakes[chull(quakes$long, quakes$lat), ]

leaflet(quakes) |>
  # Base groups
  addTiles(group = "OSM (default)") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "World Imagery (satellite)") |>
  # Overlay groups
  addCircles(
    ~long,
    ~lat,
    ~ 10^mag / 5,
    stroke = FALSE,
    group = "Quakes",
    fillColor = "tomato"
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = outline,
    lng = ~long,
    lat = ~lat,
    fill = FALSE,
    weight = 2,
    color = "#FFFFCC",
    group = "Outline"
  ) |>
  addMarkers(~long, ~lat, popup = ~ as.character(mag), label = ~ as.character(mag), group = "Marker") |>
  # Layers control
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c(
      "OSM (default)",
      "World Imagery (satellite)"
    ),
    overlayGroups = c("Quakes", "Outline", "Marker"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```
